record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, replace tied unit-normalized embeddings with ordinary trainable tied embeddings initialized as in the incumbent, preserving zero padding (embedding). Use softplus(negative-positive)+0.2*[softplus(-positive)+softplus(negative)] plus 1e-4 times the mean squared norm of nonpadding history, positive and negative embeddings (objective). Free item magnitudes may capture confidence lost through unit normalization; explicit norm regularization may control score inflation. Keep all optimizer settings, GRU topology, sampling and history unchanged.

category_rationales.rationale: Retain the mixed pairwise and pointwise objective and add 1e-4 regularization on the mean squared norm of nonpadding history, positive and negative embeddings. This controls magnitude growth when embedding normalization is removed across all four category models.

Remove unit normalization from the shared trainable item table, preserving its initialization, dimensions, tying and zero padding. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference remain consistent without checkpoint shape changes.
